trigger.question: whether the current exact Polymarket BTC 5-minute resolution contract remains incompatible with the retained current Predict.fun BTC/USDT round contract

question: Does the exact preselected Polymarket market resolve from BTC/USD 60-second TWAP with Up including equality, rather than Predict.fun BTC/USDT point reports with a separate Flat state and emergency close path?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one exact future public Polymarket Gamma event
endpoint_classification.source_contract: Use only exact title, interval, resolution source, description, boundary, and fallback fields. Ignore every price, fee, liquidity, volume, token, reward, and book field; this population is rule-rejection-only.

decision.reject_cross_venue_identity: reject without books if any feed pair, averaging window, timestamp, equality treatment, flat state, buffer, fallback, or emergency resolution path differs from retained Predict.fun terms
decision.advance: none unless every rule field is exact; title and interval equality are insufficient

retry_policy: This exact future event request is one-use. Preserve missing, not-created, shell, block, or source-gate failure. Do not substitute another interval or timestamp after observation.
